content:
helen_pm: Quick one 12 moving an IC from Product Manager II (EMEA) -> Senior PM after an internal transfer to US org. Director signed. Manager asked for effective 2025-02-01 to match performance cycle. Two catches: equity cliff/refresh timing and whether we can backdate pay without triggering double-tax. Thoughts?

lina_hr: Congrats! Cross-org transfers are messy. Two separate flows: 1) Title + base change via Role Change packet, 2) Equity/refresh via Equity Recommendation. For effective date 2025-02-01 you need final approvals to payroll by payroll cutoff (michael will confirm). Equity timing is independent  grants processed on grant date; moving org may change plan eligibility.

helen_pm: Manager wants no retro to keep comp clean, but they want title effective 2/1 for promotion messaging. Can we do title-only effective 2/1 and apply base change later?

lina_hr: You can record title change in HRIS ("title effective" field) without changing base. But beware calibration/comp cycles  if title is recorded before calibration it may affect banding. Document in packet: "title-only. base change pending payroll approval".

helen_pm: If we do title-only, does equity eligibility switch immediately? Manager worries about cliff start date.

lina_hr: Equity eligibility is governed by Compensation and by the grant rules of the receiving entity. Often eligibility aligns to official transfer date in HRIS. If manager wants cliff to start 2/1, attach request to Equity form and CC comp@redwood with rationale. They will evaluate whether to align grant date or keep original vesting schedule.

todd_finance: Finance note on currency/tax: transferring from EMEA payroll to US payroll can create a tax event if base is backdated. To avoid complex reconciliations, prefer title-only on 2/1 and base/payroll change on the first US pay period after transfer. If you must backdate pay, Finance needs FX and withholding calc time  expect 5-7 business days.

michael_payroll: Cutoff: for a 2025-02-01 effective base change without manual retro, final approved packet must reach payroll inbox by 2025-01-20 EOD. If approvals come after that we'll process retro back to 2/1. For cross-border transfers, we also need payroll transfer confirmation from global payroll ops. That adds ~3 business days.

helen_pm: Okay. There's a secondary issue  last month we accidentally paid a one-time relocation stipend that included a discretionary top-up; if we apply a base increase now payroll flagged it might result in an overpayment (we already paid some of the bump as stipend). How to avoid double paying?

michael_payroll: Important: when you submit Role Change packet include a payroll comment: "previous one-time relocation paid on 2024-12-15: $3,000; please deduct from base increase if approved." If base increase is permanent, payroll will net the prior one-time payments in the first pay period or mark clawback depending on tax timing. If funds already taxed in different jurisdiction we may need manual correction. Attach relocation payment evidence.

todd_finance: If the relocation was paid by EMEA payroll, converting to US base could require an FX reconciliation and potential reclaim. Finance prefers handling as a separate Comp Adj where we explicitly state offset: "apply base +$10,000 less prior relocation $3,000". That gives clean audit trail.

lina_hr: TL;DR checklist for you @helen_pm: 1) Submit Role Change packet and mark whether title-only or title+base, 2) attach director approval + relocation payment proof, 3) submit Equity Recommendation if you want cliff aligned, 4) confirm transfer date with Global Payroll ops, 5) note payroll comment for offset.

helen_pm: Great. One last: if we do title-only now and base later, what do we tell the IC about effective comp date if they ask? Manager prefers to be transparent.

lina_hr: Tell them: "Title effective 2025-02-01. Base adjustment pending payroll approvals; expected in pay period starting 2025-02-15. Any approved backpay (if processed) will be applied to effective date." Keep written note in packet so we have record.

people-ops-bot: Helpful links: Role Change portal https://hr.redwood.internal/role-change, Equity request https://comp.redwood.internal/equity-request, Payroll deadlines https://payroll.redwood.internal/deadlines. Required fields: employee name, ID, current title, new title, proposed base (or note "title-only"), effective date, manager rationale, director approval, budget code, transfer payroll ID.
